name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 14 – Am 12
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 14a. Affirms that any reconstruction process must be inclusive and must ensure that the Ukrainian people retain control over their natural resources and public services; opposes any attempts to impose privatisation or austerity on the Ukrainian people;
